summary: Grilled the plan on the three genuine design forks. All resolved to the fail-safe/minimal/scoped options; remaining choices are mechanical and folded into the plan.
gaps: No existing repo-kind discriminator (Codex-confirmed): manifest/VENDORED_FROM absence is shared with pre-manifest clients, so an absence-based signal would freeze a real client's factory/ during planning (AC #2 regression).
Marker cannot be hand-written: the hook denies raw .factory/ writes (evidence-only), so committing the sentinel needs a path.
Product/machinery classification is duplicated across 4 gates (pre_tool_use, pr_ready, check_refactor_delta, stages); adding a 5th tuned copy would violate 0005's spirit.
Story text literally lists docs/ as product, but locking docs/ would block spec/architecture authoring during planning and adds little protection (decisions/memory are script-written).
resolutions: Discriminator = positive .factory/harness-source.json sentinel; is_harness_source_repo = marker exists. Fail-safe: missing marker => today's exempt behavior, no client ever wrongly locked. Recorded as decision 0030's chosen mechanism with the absence-based alternative rejected.
Marker gets ONE entry in the hook's .factory/ write-allowlist (same exemption scratchpad.md has) since it is static config, not recorded evidence; created in the same task that edits the hook.

Scope this story to the lock only (pre_tool_use + a shared is_harness_source_repo seam); file a deferral with a trigger to later harmonize pr_ready/check_refactor_delta/stages onto the shared classifier, honoring 0005 without entrenching a 5th copy.

Lock machinery trees only (factory/, constitution/, harness/, .claude/, .codex/); keep docs/, plans/, .factory/, prototype/, .github/, and exempt root files writable in both repo kinds. Faithful to the intent (gate machinery needs a plan) without ceremony on discovery/planning content.
open_items: Deferred (non-blocking, tracked): harmonize the 4 product/machinery classifiers onto one repo-kind-aware classifier; trigger = any of the 4 needs a path-set change again.
